lamps.lamp: Turn Signal Lamp / Hazard Warning Indicator
lamps.flashing: Confirms whether outside turn signal or hazard flasher works normally. If the green arrow does not flash, inspect fuse and bulb.

lamps.lamp: Engine Oil Pressure Too Low Warning Lamp
lamps.steady: Indicates engine oil pressure has dropped to a dangerous level. Stop engine and check oil level immediately.
Indicates a charging system fault. Drive off the lane safely, stop, and check the drive belt.
Illuminates when the front fog lamp is turned on.

lamps.lamp: Coolant Temperature Too High Warning Lamp
lamps.steady: Indicates excessively high coolant temperature and the engine has overheated. Do not continue driving.
Illuminates when the rear fog lamp is turned on.
Illuminates when the position lamp is turned on.
Illuminates when the headlamp high beam is turned on.
Illuminates upon occurrence of any component or subsystem fault related to the emission system.
lamps.flashing: Indicates serious misfire detected, which can cause damage to the catalytic converter.

lamps.steady: Indicates possibility of an ABS fault if illuminated during driving. Have the system inspected.
Indicates the electronic power steering system has detected a fault. Steering will demand much greater effort.
Indicates an airbag system fault, meaning the airbag will deactivate and fail to trigger in an accident.
lamps.flashing: Indicates an airbag system fault, meaning the airbag will deactivate and fail to trigger in an accident.

lamps.steady: Indicates parking brake is engaged, brake fluid level is too low, or an EBD system fault has occurred.
Illuminates when the door is opened and goes out after the engine is started to show normal operation.
Illuminates if the driver does not fasten the seat belt properly after the ignition switch is turned on.
lamps.flashing: Flashes if vehicle speed exceeds 20 km/h and seat belt remains unfastened.

lamps.steady: Illuminates if the front passenger seat is occupied and the occupant does not fasten the seat belt properly.
lamps.flashing: Flashes if vehicle speed exceeds 20 km/h and front passenger seat belt remains unfastened.

lamps.lamp: Fuel Level Too Low Warning Lamp
lamps.steady: Indicates fuel amount in the fuel tank is insufficient and you should replenish fuel in time.
Illuminates when the electronic parking brake is pulled up, indicating the vehicle is parked.

lamps.lamp: Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) Fault Warning Lamp
lamps.steady: Indicates an electronic parking brake fault or warning lamp fault, which can cause the vehicle to coast.
Illuminates when the automatic vehicle hold function works and the vehicle is being parked.

lamps.lamp: Automatic Vehicle Hold (AVH) Fault Warning Lamp
lamps.steady: Indicates an automatic vehicle hold function module fault or warning lamp fault.
Indicates an ESC fault if it keeps illuminated.
lamps.flashing: Indicates the ESC function is currently being triggered.

lamps.steady: Illuminates when certain functions of ESC are deactivated by pressing the ESC OFF switch.
Indicates an automatic transmission system fault.
lamps.flashing: Indicates an automatic transmission system fault.

lamps.lamp: Cruise Control System Working Condition Indicator
lamps.steady: Illuminates when the cruise control function is activated.
Illuminates when tyre pressure is too low or too high, or when a TPMS fault occurs.
Indicates when the vehicle start / stop function is functioning and automatically starting or stopping the engine.
Indicates the DPF is blocked completely or partially, which may affect engine power performance.
Indicates water is mixed with fuel. Immediately drain the water through the bottom of the water separator.
Illuminates when the Diesel Exhaust Fluid level is low. Fill the tank with at least 5 liters of DEF.

lamps.lamp: Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF) Injection System Failure Warning Light
lamps.steady: Illuminates if an unknown fluid not conforming with acceptable characteristics is inserted, or if average DEF consumption over 50% is detected.
